correctness.rationale: Projected-edge geometry and all cut-normal squared norms follow algebraically from the unsigned incidence matrix. The log-volume optimum for coordinate facets is spherical; co-singleton rank inequalities exclude it only for n=4,5. The remaining inequality profile is analytically unimodal in subset cardinality, and the n=4,5 solutions satisfy every subset constraint. Explicit positive contact weights satisfy both John identities in the entire (m-1)-dimensional intrinsic space and rule out all off-center and non-invariant ellipsoids. Standalone rational checks cover n=4..299, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full max-volume ellipsoid of a natural spanning-tree polytope with exponentially many cut constraints is classified by two explicit spectra, all tangent-facet orbits, and constructive global John weights. A sharp jump to roundness at graph order six is geometrically non-obvious, cannot be inferred from the already-known largest inscribed ball alone, and meaningfully distinguishes determinants from radius maximization.
